```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Dart SDK
      uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
      with:
        channel: 'stable'
        flutter-version: '2.10.0'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: flutter pub get

    - name: Fix version reporting
      run: |
        # Read versions from pubspec files
        MCP_VERSION=$(grep "version:" packages/marionette_mcp/pubspec.yaml | sed 's/version: //')
        FLUTTER_VERSION=$(grep "version:" packages/marionette_flutter/pubspec.yaml | sed 's/version: //')

        # Check if versions match
        if [ "$MCP_VERSION" != "$FLUTTER_VERSION" ]; then
          echo "Error: Versions do not match!"
          exit 1
        fi

        # Generate version.g.dart
        echo "const String version = '$MCP_VERSION';" > packages/marionette_mcp/lib/version.g.dart

    - name: Run code review and security checks
      run: |
        dart analyze .
        dart format --set-exit-if-changed .

    - name: Test
      run: flutter test

  publish:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Dart SDK
      uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
      with:
        channel: 'stable'
        flutter-version: '2.10.0'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: flutter pub get

    - name: Check for version.g.dart changes
      run: |
        git diff --quiet packages/marionette_mcp/lib/version.g.dart || (echo "Error: version.g.dart has changed!" && exit 1)

    - name: Publish package
      run: flutter pub publish --dry-run
```
